items.summary: Amazon OpenSearch Serverless now offers intelligent ingestion, a fully managed feature that turns logs and documents stored in Amazon S3 into searchable content in Amazon OpenSearch Serverless (NextGen) collections . items.title: Amazon OpenSearch Service introduces intelligent ingestion for logs and documents in Amazon S3

items.summary:
Amazon MSK Connect (Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka Connect) now supports pausing and resuming connectors, letting you temporarily pause a connector from processing records and resume it later. This is useful when you need to stop data flow during maintenance on a source database or a sink target, or to pause processing while you investigate an upstream or downstream issue. 
Amazon MSK Connect is a fully managed service that allows you to deploy, monitor, and scale Apache Kafka Connect
items.title: Amazon MSK Connect now supports pausing and resuming connectors

items.summary:
AWS Lambda MicroVMs is now available in 4 additional AWS Regions: Asia Pacific (Hong Kong), Asia Pacific (Malaysia), Asia Pacific (Thailand), and Europe (Spain). With this launch, you can use Lambda MicroVMs in a total of 14 AWS Regions. 
Lambda MicroVMs is a serverless compute primitive that provides VM-level isolation, near-instant launch and resume speeds, and state preservation for executing user or AI generated code.  Developers can use Lambda MicroVMs to give each user or job their ow
items.title: AWS Lambda MicroVMs is now available in 4 additional AWS regions

items.summary: Migration assessments in AWS Transform now evaluate on-premises storage for migration to AWS. Instead of manually analyzing thousands of volumes across protocols, capacity, and performance, you upload a storage inventory and AWS Transform does the mapping for you. It matches each workload to the best-fit service, sizes the recommendation, and projects costs to produce a total cost of ownership business case. Bring NAS shares, SAN LUNs, direct-attached disks, or backup repositories via a NetApp D
items.title: AWS Transform adds storage migration assessments for Amazon S3, EBS, EFS, and FSx

items.summary:
Starting today, you can reserve compute capacity for your Amazon Aurora and Amazon RDS DB instances in one or more Availability Zones for as long as you need it. Reserving capacity helps ensure that DB instance create, restore, scale-compute, and start operations don't fail because of insufficient capacity. 
On-Demand Capacity Reservations are designed for workloads that need assurance that specific DB instance capacity will be available when they need it for business-critical events, such as mi
items.title: Amazon Aurora and Amazon RDS now support On-Demand Capacity Reservations

items.summary:
AWS Neuron 2.33 is now available, introducing TorchNeuron, the native PyTorch backend for AWS Trainium, in public beta. You can run models written with the standard PyTorch APIs on Amazon EC2 Trn2 and Trn3 instances, in eager mode or with torch.compile. This release also introduces Neuron Observer in public beta, which detects Trainium health issues in under a second and identifies the affected node or device. 
The vLLM Neuron plugin upgrades to vLLM 0.29.0, and the vLLM Omni Neuron plugin for W
items.title: AWS Neuron 2.33 adds native PyTorch support, Neuron Observer, and other new features

items.summary: Amazon S3 server access log delivery to Amazon CloudWatch Logs is now available in the AWS GovCloud (US) Regions, AWS European Sovereign Cloud, and AWS China Regions. With your access logs in CloudWatch Logs, you can query them as they arrive, set alarms, and encrypt them with AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys. This new delivery path complements the existing delivery of server access logs to S3 general purpose buckets, giving you more flexibility in how you monitor and analyze access to
items.title: Amazon S3 server access log delivery to Amazon CloudWatch Logs now available in five additional AWS Regions

items.summary:
AWS announces Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) Gateway, a new resource that simplifies ingress networking for containerized applications by dynamically provisioning and managing Application Load Balancers (ALBs) and their supporting resources directly in your account. 
With ECS Gateway, platform teams define organizational networking standards once on a gateway and associate it with one or more clusters, giving organizations a centralized way to govern how traffic reaches their ECS
items.title: Announcing Amazon ECS Gateway, a managed ingress solution for your ECS services

items.summary:
AWS Clean Rooms now supports Databricks as a data source, so collaboration members and their partners can securely analyze data managed in Databricks without moving or revealing the source data. Members query a Databricks table shared through Delta Sharing directly in a collaboration. Databricks joins AWS Glue, Snowflake, and Amazon Athena as supported data sources in AWS Clean Rooms. 
Previously, members with data in Databricks had to export or replicate it into Amazon S3 to use it as a table i
items.title: AWS Clean Rooms now supports Databricks as a data source

items.summary: Today, Amazon CloudWatch announces support for including alarm tags in action payloads and Amazon EventBridge events, enabling customers to route and filter alarm notifications by tag without additional lookups. When enabled on an alarm, CloudWatch adds the alarm tags to the messages it sends to Amazon SNS, AWS Lambda, and Amazon EventBridge each time the alarm changes state. This option is designed for customers who route many alarms through a shared notification pipeline and need to identify t
items.title: Amazon CloudWatch Alarms now supports tags in alarm actions payload

items.summary:
Amazon ElastiCache Serverless for Valkey now supports online migration from self-managed Valkey and Redis OSS on Amazon EC2 with zero downtime. Zero downtime means zero Errors returned to the client during migration, measured the same way the ElastiCache SLA measures availability. Your application continues reading and writing through cutover, and you do not need third-party replication tools. 
Online migration runs in three steps. You prepare the migration, start the data sync, and complete the
items.title: Amazon ElastiCache Serverless for Valkey now supports online migration with zero downtime

items.summary:
EC2 Image Builder now supports using existing instances from an Auto Scaling Group (ASG) for building images, enabling faster builds by eliminating the time spent in launching and bootstrapping new instances and reusing already running EC2 instances. 
With this feature, you can provide an ASG in your Image Builder infrastructure configuration. Instead of launching a new instance at the build time, Image Builder selects an already-running instance from this ASG, applies your build components, and
items.title: EC2 Image Builder now integrates with ASG for faster image builds

items.summary:
Amazon GuardDuty now supports optional detection rules for Runtime Monitoring. You can enable more than 50 Runtime Monitoring rules that help detect process, file, and network activity that might be routine in one environment but a sign of compromise in another, such as modifying sudoers files or disabling audit logging. 
The new rules provide detections for Amazon EC2 instances, Amazon EKS, and Amazon ECS on both EC2 and AWS Fargate, and span 13 finding types mapped to MITRE ATT&CK® tactics
items.title: Amazon GuardDuty adds optional threat detection rules for Runtime Monitoring

items.summary: Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) Custom for SQL Server now supports the latest Cumulative Updates (CU) and General Distribution Release (GDR) updates for Microsoft SQL Server. This release includes support for SQL Server 2019 CU32+GDR KB5122772(RDS version 15.00.4490.9.v1) and SQL Server 2022 CU26 + GDR KB5122768 (RDS version 16.00.4275.2.v1).  For additional information on the improvements and fixes included in these updates, see Microsoft documentation for KB5122772 and KB512276
items.title: Amazon RDS Custom now supports the latest Cumulative Update and GDR updates for Microsoft SQL Server

items.summary:
Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) for SQL Server now supports creating DB snapshots directly on read replica instances. Previously, you could create snapshots only on standalone and primary DB instances. You can now snapshot a read replica without promoting it first, giving you more flexibility in your backup and disaster recovery (DR) workflows. 
Previously, enabling Multi-AZ on a promoted read replica meant waiting for an initial full snapshot to finish before the conversion coul
items.title: Amazon RDS for SQL Server now supports snapshots on read replicas

llm.detail: 攻擊者突破多層獨立防禦，於 1.107.0 版本的 Docker Hub 映像檔與 PyPI 套件中植入憑證竊取器與後門。官方初步調查指出發布憑證外洩可能與日誌管理不當直接相關。
llm.recommended_action: 檢查專案鎖定檔與容器部屬紀錄是否包含 LiteLLM 1.107.0，並立即輪替生產環境相關雲端與 API 金鑰。
llm.summary: LiteLLM 疑似因 AI Gateway 日誌外洩 GitHub Token 導致 release pipeline 遭劫持並釋出惡意版本。
llm.why_it_matters: 若 Python 或 Kubernetes 服務中有依賴 LiteLLM 串接 LLM，在受害時間窗口內拉取最新套件的環境可能已被植入後門並流出敏感設定。

items.summary:
LiteLLM on Wednesday disclosed that threat actors compromised "multiple independent security controls" to push a malicious version of the Python package containing a credential stealer and a backdoor.

On October 21, 2026, LiteLLM's release pipeline was compromised to push 1.107.0 to the Docker Hub registry and the Python Package Index (PyPI) repository. The incident took place around 4:00 a.m.
items.title: LiteLLM Suspects GitHub Token Leak in AI Gateway Logs Behind Malicious Package Release

llm.detail: 多家資安機構報告指出該惡意版本夾帶環境變數與敏感資訊搜刮模組，影響範圍涵蓋 PyPI wheels 與官方 Docker 映像檔。目前套件管理平台已介入防堵，但已下載者需自行處置。
llm.recommended_action: 強制將 LiteLLM 版本降級或鎖定至已知安全的 release（如 1.106.x），並稽核 CI/CD pipeline 的快取與建置歷程。
llm.summary: LiteLLM 1.107.0 遭軟體供應鏈攻擊植入後門，PyPI 官方已緊急將該版本隔離下架。
llm.why_it_matters: 採用自動建置流程拉取最新版 Python 依賴的系統，可能已在無意間將竊密木馬部署進內部伺服器或容器群組中。

items.summary:
The popular LiteLLM Python package has been compromised as part of a software supply chain attack that delivered a credential stealer and a backdoor, according to reports from SafeDep, Socket, StepSecurity, and Upwind.

The compromise affects LiteLLM 1.107.0, distributed through PyPI wheels and Docker images. The Python package has since been quarantined on Python Package Index (PyPI), and the
items.title: LiteLLM Compromised in Supply Chain Attack Delivering Credential Stealer and Backdoor

llm.detail: 該分析探討 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 在 AWS 託管 Python 執行環境中的邊界隔離弱點。研究展示如何繞過現有安全限制與受限命名空間，取得底層主機未經授權的系統執行權限。
llm.recommended_action: 檢視現行 Python 沙箱邊界配置，考慮採用 gVisor 或微虛擬化（MicroVM）架構提供強隔離層。
llm.summary: 資安研究員揭露針對 AWS MCP Python 沙箱環境的逃逸技術分析。
llm.why_it_matters: 團隊若正在評估或導入 MCP 架構執行動態產生的 Python 腳本，預設沙箱防護可能無法有效抵禦特權提升或逃逸攻擊。

llm.detail: 此漏洞源於解壓縮特製數據時會發生緩衝區越界覆寫，進而破壞記憶體狀態導致崩潰甚至 RCE。除了 Node.js 之外，Python 的 brotli 與 brotlicffi 套件以及 Envoy 等中介軟體均存在相同風險。
llm.recommended_action: 全面盤點專案與環境中的 brotli 和 brotlicffi 依賴版本，並盡速升級至整合上游安全修補的最新版本。
llm.summary: Google Brotli 解碼器記憶體損毀漏洞（CVE-2026-111497）波及 Python、Bun 與代理伺服器。
llm.why_it_matters: 團隊若在 Python 爬蟲、API Client 或反向代理層啟用 Brotli 自動解壓縮外部未過濾流量，可能面臨服務阻斷或遠端執行風險。

items.summary:
A memory-corruption flaw in Google's Brotli decoder sits in many programs that unpack Brotli-compressed data, among them Bun, the Python Brotli and brotlicffi packages, and Envoy proxies set up to decompress Brotli.

Tracked as CVE-2026-111497, the flaw allows crafted compressed data to overwrite past the end of a buffer and corrupt a program's memory, potentially
items.title: Brotli Decoder Flaw Behind Node.js RCE Also Affects Bun, Python and Other Widely Used Software

llm.detail: 官方說明早在 2026 年 5 月底，一組 Agent Platform 的主金鑰即不慎被提交至公開的 lite-harness 專案中。攻擊者以此金鑰長期潛伏並竊取內部 GitHub Token，最終掌握了 PyPI 與 Docker Hub 的發布特權。
llm.recommended_action: 在團隊各儲存庫全面導入 git-secrets 或 TruffleHog 等預先攔截工具，禁止任何敏感憑證進入版本控制系統。
llm.summary: LiteLLM 坦承因在公開 GitHub 儲存庫誤傳 Master Key，導致發布管道全面失守。
llm.why_it_matters: 這起事件展示了憑證洩漏如何引發下游廣泛的供應鏈災難，凸顯自動化部署管線與憑證分離管理的重要性。

items.summary:
LiteLLM on Friday revealed that an Agent Platform master key accidentally published to a public GitHub repository in late May 2026 ultimately allowed the threat actor to push a malicious version of the popular Python package.

"On May 27, 2026, a configuration file was committed to the public LiteLLM-Labs/lite-harness repository which inadvertently contained the master key to a deployment of
items.title: Leaked LiteLLM Master Key Let Attackers Steal GitHub Tokens and Hijack Release Pipeline

llm.detail: Ruby 4.0.9、3.4.12 與 3.3.13 解決了正則表達式編譯時發生的記憶體損毀問題。攻擊者若能控制或傳入精心設計的正則表達式，可直接在運行 Ruby 直譯器的伺服器上執行任意程式碼。
llm.recommended_action: 立即將生產環境伺服器與 Docker 基礎映像檔中的 Ruby 升級至 3.3.13、3.4.12 或更新版本。
llm.summary: Ruby 正式釋出安全性更新，修復內建 Onigmo 正則引擎中導致 GitLab RCE 的三項漏洞。
llm.why_it_matters: Rails 與 Sidekiq 服務若包含使用者自訂正則或未過濾動態輸入編譯 regex 的邏輯，整個底層服務與資料庫憑證均可能暴露於被接管的高風險中。

items.summary:
Ruby has released versions 4.0.9, 3.4.12, and 3.3.13 to fix three bugs in Onigmo, the regular expression engine built into the language. The bugs lie behind four critical security flaws that GitLab patched over the past month.

GitLab found that a specially crafted pattern could corrupt memory while Ruby compiles it, potentially leading to code execution on its own servers.

Ruby says any
items.title: Ruby Fixes Three Regex Engine Bugs Responsible for Four Critical GitLab RCE Flaws

llm.detail: 資安監控機構表示先前引發高度戒備的 PHP 緊急漏洞已獲得多數廠商修補與社群掌握，當前威脅態勢已趨於平穩，維運團隊可重回標準監控流程。
llm.summary: SANS ISC 宣布將 PHP 相關威脅警報等級調降回正常狀態（Infocon Green）。
llm.why_it_matters: 因技術棧以 Ruby、Go、Python 與 Node.js 為主，此 PHP 威脅警報解除對目前核心架構無直接技術影響。

items.summary: This morning, we returned to Infocon Green. As usual, we are raising the Infocon to alert you to emerging situations requiring immediate attention. PHP fit that description. By now, you either know about it, or you probably never will, so it is time to go back to "business as usual".
items.title: PHP Vulnerability Wrap-Up, (Fri, Oct 23rd)

llm.detail: 缺陷存在於處理 EPS 向量圖檔的邏輯，Pillow 在呼叫外部 Ghostscript 轉譯像素時未對傳入的檔名做嚴格驗證與跳脫處理，導致作業系統層級的命令注入。
llm.recommended_action: 更新 Pillow 套件至修復版本，或在應用程式中明確拒絕處理 EPS 格式並自主機移除 Ghostscript。
llm.summary: Python 圖像處理庫 Pillow 爆發重大漏洞（CVE-2026-112900），處理特製圖檔可引發指令執行。
llm.why_it_matters: 若後端 Python API 允許用戶上傳圖片並透過 Pillow 進行縮圖或格式驗證，攻擊者可藉由惡意命名檔名直接取得後台主機 shell 權限。

items.summary:
Pillow, the most widely used image library for Python, can be made to run operating system commands on a server by specifying the name of a file it is told to open.

The flaw, CVE-2026-112900, is in the way Pillow handles EPS images, which it opens by passing the file's name to Ghostscript, a separate program it runs to turn the image into pixels, without checking the name first.
items.title: Critical Flaw in Python’s Popular Pillow Image Library Allows Code Execution via a Crafted Image

llm.detail: 攻擊者在此次 ConnectWise Cloud Backup 事件中利用 ARTEX 進行自動化滲透測試與環境探測，顯著縮短了橫向移動的時間。該工具具備自主代理能力，先前曾被用於針對南韓金融機構的攻擊，隨後已轉為封閉原始碼，顯示國家級駭客正積極將 AI 工具武器化。
llm.recommended_action: 盤點基礎設施中所有第三方備份與管理代理程式，並在主機端透過 EDR 阻擋未簽署的 Go 執行檔執行與異常外連行為。
llm.summary: 微軟揭露中國駭客組織 Storm-0940 滲透 ConnectWise 供應鏈，並導入 Go 語言開發的 ARTEX AI Agent 加速攻擊流程。
llm.why_it_matters: 雲端備份與維運管理軟體通常在主機或 Kubernetes 節點具備極高權限，一旦供應鏈失守且遭遇 AI Agent 自動化滲透，攻擊者能在幾分鐘內橫向擴展至關鍵容器或內部服務。

items.summary:
Microsoft on Wednesday disclosed that a China state-aligned actor dubbed Storm-0940 was behind the recent supply chain compromise of the ConnectWise Cloud Backup application.

During the incident, Storm-0940 used ARTEX, a Go-based agentic AI penetration testing framework that was made closed-source in the wake of its abuse in cyber attacks targeting South Korean financial institutions, to speed
items.title: China-Linked Hackers Use ARTEX AI Agents in ConnectWise Supply Chain Attack

Kimi K3.1 Pro landed on the Kimi API today - it's not yet open weights, but Moonshot  promise "Full model weights will be released by Nov 4, 2026".
